sections.text:
Clean the cooling air entry side by 
 using fine brush.

Blow out the cooler by compressed air 
 or spray with a water jet in the opposite direction to the cooling airflow.
Be care to not distort the fins.

Use a team of jet blower with high 
 wetting agents to clean and get rid of any dirts if the cooler has a layer of 
 grease or oil. The jet should be in the opposite direction of the airflow. Dry the airside after cleaning.

Connect the oil side to a closed 
 cleaning unit with forced circulation and filter unit; use trichoroethyline as 
 a cleaning agent with 60C temperature.

Flushing should be done from both 
 sides for 30 minutes approximately.

Quantity of water [150 300 L /
